name: Fine M-Tec Co.,Ltd.
summary: Fine M-Tech Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacture and supply of precision instrument parts. Its products include foldable metal plate, hinge modules, mobile phone parts, and electric vehicle car parts. It operates through the following business divisions: IT Parts, IT Components, and Others. The company was founded on June 21, 2001 and is headquartered in Anyang-si, South Korea.
